title: Restored records under independent serial futures
selection: For block offset i, history=i%4 and selected_case=i//4; assignment fixed before teaching. No pass/fail selection or replacement.
record_encoding: 512 little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 weights in 4096 bytes
primary_inference: four equally weighted history strata; 64 independent block/record averages; approximate Welch-Satterthwaite one-sided 95% lower bound
record_probability_intervals: two-sided exact binomial 95% pointwise; simultaneous family of 64*3*2 also reported
forecast_status: secondary transport test of unchanged TT008 coefficients; no prediction of repair benefit
prerequisites: native branching and terminal-assay implementation qualified
final protocol and inputs registered before new cohort generation
